findings.violated_requirement: FR-039/FR-041/FR-042; T070 immutable original request plus same-invocation independently proven task tracking.
findings.observed_deficiency: Every scoped adapter rebinds original tasks.md hash to current bytes; standalone validator also demands original markers and full requested IDs equal currently unfinished tasks. Reproduction: original scope ready, one authorized checkbox completion then implementation-scope-required-source-binding-missing. Reconstructing scope would lose the frozen request/history, so ordinary completion prevents re-entry.
findings.exact_correction: Retain original request identity/digest and initial task records, validate separately current task state through independently proven marker/revision successor records. Support ordinary exact Tasker tracking and declared task-plan revision without rewriting original scope or resetting history/counters; reject unrelated task/spec/pointer drift. Add current controller and installed same-invocation positive/negative regression cases.

findings.violated_requirement: FR-027/FR-032; T055 executable compatible Specify lifecycle route.
findings.observed_deficiency: Actual production graph version0.2.0 is rejected by delivered owner0.3.0 minimum Specify0.3.0. After temporary-only version normalization, owner still rejects lifecycle-owner-route-unavailable because milestone Write node lacks explicit type: command. Owner fixture graphs use compatible versions and explicit command types.
findings.exact_correction: Deliver a compatible explicit command route and truthful owning graph version in this source task; reconcile matching bundle pins via T062. Verify owner preparation using actual source/installed Specify graph, not a fabricated owner graph.

findings.violated_requirement: FR-028/FR-032; T056 executable owner handoff before Coder.
findings.observed_deficiency: Production graph duplicates cases.blocked and cases.default at its tail. Delivered owner strict YAML loader rejects workflow contains duplicate key blocked; after temporary-only duplicate normalization, lifecycle owner route still unavailable because milestone Write node lacks explicit type: command. No valid current production graph can prepare startup effect.
findings.exact_correction: Remove duplicated branch keys without dropping declared stop behavior, declare the milestone Write node as type: command, and prove current production graph loads through strict owner validation and reaches ready before Coder only with complete proof.

findings.violated_requirement: FR-029/FR-032; T057 executable compatible Close Out lifecycle route.
findings.observed_deficiency: Actual production graph version0.7.0 is rejected by delivered owner0.3.0 minimum CloseOut0.8.0. After temporary-only version normalization, owner still rejects lifecycle-owner-route-unavailable because milestone Write node lacks explicit type: command.
findings.exact_correction: Deliver compatible explicit owner Write node and truthful graph version in this owning source task; reconcile bundle pin through T062. Exercise real production Close Out graph with current full-scope owner proof before allowing debrief.

findings.violated_requirement: FR-032/FR-033; T057/T058/T060 bounded ordered stale-state recovery.
findings.observed_deficiency: Request prompt permits bounded recovery, but graph has only one prepare/revalidate/write/verify sequence. Write and verification accept only in-progress-to-implemented. From planned recovery the owner first proposes planned-to-specced, which current effect/verification instructions cannot accept, and no declared successor loop recollects current evidence for the next two edges. Owner tests exercise repeated manual helper calls, not this graph.
findings.exact_correction: Declare a bounded at-most-three-edge recovery route with fresh preflight/collection/revalidation, exact owning-phase evidence and independently verified receipt per adjacent edge; accept only the actual proposed edge below current phase ceiling, stop missing/contradictory proof precisely, and reach debrief only after final implemented verification. Synchronize T058 projections/docs and T060/T061 actual graph cases.

findings.violated_requirement: T053 strict positive and negative contract fixtures before adapter; no forbidden null placeholders.
findings.observed_deficiency: Canonical proposal-one-adjacent-edge is marked accepted but has empty snapshot/decision and recovery:null, so strict proposal validation rejects it. Accepted prepare/recovery/evidence examples lack current required proof and are not materialized/executed by the harness. Most cases are descriptive entries; tests generate independent minimal requests and only directly execute receipt cases. Thus accepted fixture labels do not establish valid contract cases.
findings.exact_correction: Materialize every canonical positive/negative fixture with contained current files/digests and complete schema/proof, eliminate forbidden nulls from accepted cases, and dispatch each case through the matching real validator/owner operation asserting its declared result. Preserve invalid null fixtures as explicit negative cases.

findings.violated_requirement: T060/T061 actual production lifecycle graph/adapter behavior and LC001-LC015 coverage.
findings.observed_deficiency: LC matrix imports and re-runs roadmap owner unit tests; those use fabricated version1.0.0 manual routes or compatible tiny graph fixtures. It does not feed actual FlowKit-produced requests and production graph payload into owner. Independent current run21tests passes while all three real production graphs fail owner preparation. LC008 repeated owner helper calls do not prove bounded production graph recovery.
findings.exact_correction: Exercise LC001-LC015 through actual installed FlowKit adapter and rendered production phase nodes with strict owner0.3 packet and source closure, including all preflights, missing/stale proofs, ordered three-edge recovery, partial outcomes and explicit verification return/defer. Preserve owner unit tests as complementary evidence and regenerate accurate current case results.

findings.violated_requirement: T072/T075 immutable substantive baseline, actual pre-dispatch history and generic prior/current progress validation.
findings.observed_deficiency: Installed SI harness fabricates a finding:fixture-progress ID and current resolved list after the source-effect write, then calls route_scoped_implementation directly instead of implementation-progress-scoped with a frozen baseline and independent resolution proof. It also keeps original task markers while claiming preparation/completion outcomes. This bypasses automatic closure validation and fails to test legitimate task-marker successor re-entry, hiding F020-LIFECYCLE-CODE-001. Reported15cases prove route predicate shapes, not the required full installed closure path.
findings.exact_correction: Capture actual original source/finding baseline before effects; use actual independent review objects and implementation-progress-scoped after effects, retain original and next baseline digests, perform exact Tasker marker transitions in fixture, and run production-rendered preparation/source/re-entry ordering with history persisted before modeled dispatch. Regenerate SI evidence retaining failed variants and never grant post-discovered finding retrospective credit.

findings.violated_requirement: T062 actual compatible owner/workflow pin reconciliation and lifecycle-delivery.json source coordinate evidence.
findings.observed_deficiency: Bundle keeps Specify0.2.0 and CloseOut0.7.0 despite owner requiring0.3.0/0.8.0; required validation/lifecycle-delivery.json does not exist. Existing lifecycle-snapshot record is an earlier valid installation record with controller ee95... and standalone scope f1fc... rather than current d4a087.../d8e179... source; it cannot establish current amended delivery compatibility.
findings.exact_correction: After owning graph fixes establish real versions, reconcile exact matching bundle/workflow/controller/owner pins, write required portable lifecycle-delivery.json with actual hashes/coordinates/CLI, refresh and revalidate current disposable snapshot through T063/T064, preserve historical snapshot evidence separately.
